title: A steadier accessibility check
summary: No changes you will notice. This release puts the quicker developer test sign-in from v0.5.5 live, with a fix to one of the automatic checks that runs before each release.

fixed: One of the automatic keyboard checks that run before each release now waits for the page to finish moving focus, so it no longer fails at random.

internal_notes: v0.5.5 (Developer QA sign-in) was released but not deployed, because the accessibility check on its tag failed on a timing race in the QA switcher keyboard check. This release fixes the check and deploys everything in v0.5.5.
The check now waits until focus is inside the open QA switcher before reading or moving it. No app code changed.
